title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
lineage: Reel master > cassette > DAT > CDR (unknown gens) > Undisclosed Noise Reduction processsing step? > ? > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a blazing Dec 1973 show with tight China>Rider jam, soaring Dark Star and fiery Phil bombs; excellent sound despite minor tape glitches.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently high‑energy – the China > Rider transition is tight, the Mind Left Body jam rolls in a rare mid‑tempo blues feel, and the Dark Star/Wharf Rat sequence erupts with loud Phil “bombs” and passionate vocals. The soundboard recording is generally clear and well‑balanced, though a few tape‑flip glitches appear on Wharf Rat. Overall the show is hailed as an exploratory masterpiece by reviewers.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars, praising musical fire and tightness; recording quality is noted as excellent with only minor glitches, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced sound; occasional glitches such as a tape‑flip on Wharf Rat that repeats a few lines.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions with a notable mid‑tempo blues jam in the Mind Left Body segment, leading into an intense Dark Star/space sequence before closing on a high‑octane Greatest Story.

band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers highlight loud Phil “bombs” and a fierce tease of The Other One, noting his powerful bass presence throughout the jam sections.
